postings.title: Temporary Capacity and Licence Management Officer
postings.description: Temporary Capacity and Licence Management Officer EUMETSAT is growing, and its IT infrastructure is a key component in supporting the organisation's business needs. Within the Infrastructure for IT and Data (I2D) Division, the Capacity and Licence Management Officer will contribute to the sustainable and efficient management of the IT infrastructure. This role will consolidate demand, plan the required growth of the IT infrastructure layer, and foster synergies and efficiencies in the procurement of IT equipment. It will also control and optimise licence usage across the IT infrastructure domain, increasing transparency in licence consumption. Its core responsibilities include: Licence allocation, avoiding licence shortages and ensuring licence compliance. Capacity monitoring, overseeing the licence and capacity status of infrastructure systems. Cost optimisation, analysing usage patterns to effectively manage licence consumption. Audit readiness, maintaining accurate inventories of deployed assets and software catalogues. NB This is not an EUMETSAT staff role. Whilst EUMETSAT is managing the recruitment process, the successful candidate will be engaged through a German AUG employment agency and will be working under their terms and conditions which will align with German Labour Law. Applicant must have right to work in Germany. No work permit or visa support will be possible. The expected duration on this temp contract is 24 months Duties Act as the focal point for capacity and licence administration within I2D, which is responsible for a large volume of assets and licences in the operational environment. Establish capacity and licence management processes at the infrastructure level (I2D) – working together with infrastructure system owners and process owners - and support their eventual extension across the organisation. Implement the agreed processes at the infrastructure level. Oversee capacity and licence administration across the IT infrastructure layer with the objective of promoting transparency, efficiency, and identifying areas for improvement. Regular reporting to management. Support internal and external licence audits. LOCATION Darmstadt, Germany QUALIFICATIONS University degree in a relevant discipline. LANGUAGES Candidates must be able to work effectively in English DEADLINE 20 October 2026 Skills and Experience Proven experience in capacity and licence management positions or in a comparable role. Demonstrated experience in drafting and implementing processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills (e.g. Excel, Power BI, etc.). Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders, and industrial partners. Employment Conditions The Temporary Capacity and Licence Management Officer will work on a full-time basis. The role will be based at the EUMETSAT headquarters in Darmstadt, Germany. Remote working will not be possible. Interviews for this position will be held in English, followed by a work-related assessment also in English. The monthly salary band for this role is Euro 4369 - Euro 5961 (Gross) based on skills and experience. The target start date is as soon as possible and the expected duration will be 24 months. This is NOT a staff role. The successful candidate would be employed through an AUG temp agency for the duration of the contract. Agency employment conditions will apply and these will be aligned with German Labour Law. Applicants will need to have the right to work in Germany. Visa or work permit support will not be provided. EUMETSAT is committed to providing an equal opportunities work environment for men and women.The EUMETSAT Convention requires that Staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, account being taken of the international character of EUMETSAT. About EUMETSAT EUMETSAT is Europe’s meteorological satellite agency. Its role is to establish and operate meteorological satellites to monitor the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide. EUMETSAT also operates several Copernicus missions on behalf of the European Union and provide data services to the Copernicus marine and atmospheric services and their users. As an intergovernmental European Organisation, EUMETSAT has 30 Member States (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey and the United Kingdom.)

These services are implemented as cloud-based data services, making use of modern software engineering, cloud-native, data and platform technologies. Within the Big Data Services team, the Data Services Engineer will contribute to the design, development and evolution of the software components and technical capabilities supporting these services. The role requires a versatile and hands-on engineer combining software development and cloud engineering skills. The post holder will be responsible for the design, maintenance and evolution of the Identity and Access Management and API management solutions within the Big Data Services portfolio, and will contribute to the development and operation of other shared technical capabilities supporting EUMETSAT's online data services, including observability, service integration, automation and CI/CD. NB This is not a staff role. This is a temporary role with an expected duration of 24 months. The incumbent will be engaged through a temporary agency and will be required to work under their terms and conditions. Applicants will be required to have the right to work in Germany. Working permits / visa support will not be provided. Duties Design, develop and evolve scalable and reliable cloud-based software components, including APIs, automation and integration solutions supporting EUMETSAT data services; Maintain and evolve Identity and Access Management and API management solutions supporting the Big Data Services portfolio, including identity federation, authentication and authorisation, API gateways and access-control mechanisms Contribute to the development and evolution of shared technical capabilities, including observability, service integration, automation and CI/CD; Apply DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering practices to improve automation, scalability, resilience and operational efficiency; Deploy and maintain data services using cloud-native technologies and Kubernetes-based platforms; Perform technical architecture activities and define and implement appropriate engineering solutions; Define technical work packages and procurement documentation, and lead the technical coordination of their execution by industrial partners; Maintain technical documentation and contribute to EUMETSAT software engineering and quality management processes; Collaborate with engineering teams, operations teams, security specialists and industrial partners involved in the development and operation of the services LOCATION Darmstadt, Germany QUALIFICATIONS University degree in relevant subject or equivalent professional experience LANGUAGES Candidates must be able to work effectively in English DEADLINE 6 October 2026 Skills and Experience Proven experience in software engineering, DevOps, SRE or a comparable role; Strong software development skills in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, Rust, Go or Java; Proven Experience in one or more relevant areas such as IAM, API gateways, cloud platforms, object storage/S3 or large-scale data services; Proven experience with Linux, containers, Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures; Experience with APIs, distributed services, CI/CD, automation and Infrastructure as Code; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define pragmatic technical solutions and adapt to evolving requirements; Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders and industrial partners. postings.title: VN 26/39 Mission Planning Operations Engineer
postings.description: VN 26/39 Mission Planning Operations Engineer EUMETSAT operates a fleet of spacecraft to observe the Earth’s atmosphere, oceans and land surfaces in support of climate monitoring, weather forecasting, oceanography and hydrology. This includes satellites both owned by EUMETSAT or operated by EUMETSAT on behalf of the European Commission’s Copernicus programme. Within the Mission Planning Team of the Flight Operations (FLO) Division, the Mission Planning Operations Engineer supports the routine operations of flying satellites, and the development & operations preparation of future missions. Duties The following duties are foreseen for this role: Manage and perform Mission Planning operations, including activity scheduling, database maintenance, support for recurrent launches, anomaly tracking and resolution, operational configuration updates, development of operational processes, training of personnel, and the development and maintenance of operational documentation; Through close liaison with other teams within EUMETSAT (particularly the Flight Dynamics, Spacecraft Operations, Mission Control Systems and Data Processing teams), understand and implement all Space and Ground segment operational needs that must be met through Mission Planning systems and processes; Contribute to evolutions of operational Mission Planning systems, software or processes, from the definition of upgrades/changes arising from evolving user requirements to the verification, validation, acceptance and documentation of updated systems. Liaise/support the in-house software maintenance team and external contractors during the upgrade process; In support of future developments, participate in the procurement, operations preparation and validation campaigns involving Mission Planning and related systems and tools; Coordinate with mission partners such as ESA, CNES, NOAA and NASA to implement mission planning and cross-support agreements; Support the Mission Planning Manager as necessary, particularly in the management of the Mission Planning Operations service team. LOCATION Darmstadt, Germany QUALIFICATIONS A university degree (or equivalent) in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline. LANGUAGES The official languages of EUMETSAT are English and French. Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and preferably have some knowledge of French. DEADLINE 15 October 2026 Skills and Experience The following skills/experience are considered mandatory: Experience in the field of Mission Planning, gained during the operations and/or development of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and/or Geostationary (GEO) satellite systems; Experience of LEO or GEO mission planning system specification, development and procurement, preferably including Assembly, Integration and Validation (AIV) related activities (test case and procedure generation; requirements tracking, verification and validation; support to test campaign management and execution; etc.); Experience producing and maintaining mission planning operational rules using JBoss Drools, and knowledge of Bash/Python; Experience in managing small teams; Ability to work proactively in a clear, structured manner with a minimum of supervision, within a small team. In particular, professional experience demonstrating personal initiative, action orientation and an ability to synthesise complex technical concepts in clear and concise formal documents and verbal presentations. The following skills/experience would be advantageous: Ability to programme in languages such as C++ or Java (or similar) for Linux and MS Windows; Experience with the Linux operating system, relational databases and SQL, preferably involving PostgreSQL, Oracle and MariaDB/MySQL; Experience with container application environments (e.g. Docker); Experience of working with files in XML format, including XML file edition, schema validation and related tools (Oxygen and/or XMLSpy), and with Git and GitLab; Experience interfacing with partner agencies and organisations, and with industrial service and product providers. Employment Conditions The initial contract will be of 4 years’ duration, with subsequent 5 year contracts being awarded thereafter, subject to individual performance and organisation requirements. There is no limit to the amount of follow-up contracts a staff member can receive up to the EUMETSAT retirement age of 63 and there are certainly opportunities to establish a long career perspective at EUMETSAT. The salary scale provides for increments on the anniversary of taking up employment, and scales are reviewed by the EUMETSAT Council with effect from 1 January each year. postings.title: VN 26/40 Contracts Officer
postings.description: VN 26/40 Contracts Officer The Contracts Division (COS) is EUMETSAT's centre of expertise for procurement, contractual and commercial matters. Its mission is to ensure that best value for money is achieved through procurements that are compliant, competitive, timely and well managed. The Division is responsible for monitoring the compliant implementation of EUMETSAT's Procurement Procedures and acts as a key partner to all areas of the Organisation throughout the procurement lifecycle. The Division provides contractual and commercial advice and support, contributes to procurement planning and strategy, participates in evaluations and negotiations, and ensures compliance with EUMETSAT's procurement and financial rules, procedures and quality standards. It negotiates and concludes contracts on behalf of the Organisation and supports the management of contractual matters during contract execution, including amendments, options, performance-related issues, remedies and contract close-out activities. EUMETSAT's procurements range from contracts valued at approximately EUR 100,000 to multi-million-euro procurements supporting major satellite programmes and operational services. Most procurements are conducted through open competitive tendering procedures and cover a diverse portfolio including launch services, ground segment developments, industrial support services, skills- and product-based service contracts, consultancy services, technical and scientific studies, information technology, general supplies, and site and facility services in support of both EUMETSAT's mandatory and optional programmes. The Contracts Officer will take contractual responsibility, as part of interdisciplinary procurement and project teams, for the preparation, negotiation and management of contracts and procurements under their assigned responsibility, including competitive tenders and in direct negotiation with single suppliers. The post holder will ensure compliance with EUMETSAT’s contractual, procurement and financial rules, whilst contributing to the achievement of best value for money. The post is currently assigned to the procurement and commercial support of service procurements in the Technical and Scientific Support and Operations and Services departments, supporting a diverse portfolio of operational, technical and engineering activities. Duties Preparation of contractual tender documentation; Review of contractual and technical tender documentation; Oversight and management of procurement actions, including negotiations; Management of contractual matters during the execution phase, including contract amendments and options; Supporting and participating in Tender Evaluation Boards; Build and maintain trusted and constructive relationships with internal customers, project teams, managers, suppliers and other stakeholders, acting as a trusted procurement partner, and facilitating effective engagement, communication and problem/solving throughout the procurement and contractual lifecycle; Contribute to the continuous improvement and transformation of EUMETSAT's procurement and contractual processes, tools and working practices, by supporting process optimisation, standardisation, digitalisation and organisational change initiatives, aimed at enhancing efficiency, compliance and quality; Preparation and negotiation of co-operation agreements with national and international partners; People management tasks. LOCATION Darmstadt, Germany QUALIFICATIONS University degree or equivalent qualification in law, economics or business studies or a professional procurement qualification with CIPS or equivalent at degree level. LANGUAGES The official languages of EUMETSAT are English and French. For this position, candidates should be fluent in English with proven drafting ability. Fluency in French would be a strong asset. . DEADLINE 20 October 2026 Skills and Experience Demonstrated experience (typically at least 5-10 years) in the procurement of supplies and/or complex services, especially through competitive public tendering, and negotiation and commercial management of contracts, for complex high technology systems, in a satellite, aerospace, or engineering environment and preferably gained in the frame of international or national public procurement; Proven experience in independently drafting and negotiating contract terms and conditions, legal provisions and dealing with contractual matters, and the ability to understand complex technical and legal issues and to formulate clear legal texts; Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the demonstrated ability to build consensus, foster collaboration, develop and sustain positive working relationships with a diverse range of technical, operational and managerial stakeholders within multidisciplinary teams, resolving issues through constructive engagement, sound judgement and effective communication; Demonstrated experience in business process improvement, organisational change or transformation initiatives, together with the ability to analyse existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, develop practical solutions, establish credibility and build support for change, and contribute to successful implementation in a complex stakeholder environment; People management experience; Experience of the Materials Management module of an ERP System (ideally SAP); Experience of working in a multi-lingual environment is desirable; Proven experience in the use of MS Office, particularly MS Word. Employment Conditions The initial contract will be of 4 years’ duration, with subsequent 5 year contracts being awarded thereafter, subject to individual performance and organisation requirements. postings.title: VN 26/42 Machine Learning Application Developer
postings.description: VN 26/42 Machine Learning Application Developer EUMETSAT generates and uses data from its growing fleet of Earth observation satellites, together with data from partner agencies, to support weather forecasting—including nowcasting and numerical weather prediction—by meteorological and other environmental agencies in its Member States and worldwide. In addition, EUMETSAT supports climate monitoring by providing a wide range of satellite data, including rescued, recalibrated and reprocessed long-term series of satellite observations. EUMETSAT also supports its users in exploiting AI/ML by applying these methods to its core data products and through dedicated data curation activities. Within the Climate Services Team of the User Support and Climate Services Division (USC), the Machine Learning Application Developer exploits satellite data using AI/ML methods to derive weather and climate information, including the identification and characterisation of Earth system features such as convective storms and fog. In addition, the post holder contributes to the development of the weather forecasting and early warning value chain, as well as to kilometre-scale climate modelling, by supporting users in integrating EUMETSAT ML-ready data into their applications and by establishing collaborations across the wider community. The team brings together staff with a wide range of world-class expertise, including weather and climate as well as Earth observation domain experts, data processing engineers, and machine learning specialists. Joining EUMETSAT in this role offers a unique opportunity to develop your professional career in a highly motivating international environment. Duties Support EUMETSAT internal and external users by creating data pipelines and curated ML-ready datasets with needed data content, quality, format, and structure for each use case; Develop, train, apply, and validate machine-learning models and other algorithms to transform Earth observation data into actionable information, particularly for Earth system feature detection; Explore and share the best ways to apply modern techniques and access Earth Observation data with the aim of helping the community to develop, train, and apply the models; Foster community development by encouraging and assisting EUMETSAT users in sharing commonly applicable parts of their applications in the form of how-to articles, code examples, infrastructure configurations, pre-trained models, datasets, etc; Take an active role in user communities and support training courses, hackathons, and other community-oriented means of spreading practical knowledge to EUMETSAT member states. LOCATION Darmstadt, Germany QUALIFICATIONS Master’s or higher degree in a relevant computing or natural sciences subject. LANGUAGES The official languages of EUMETSAT are English and French. Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and be willing to learn French. DEADLINE 28 October 2026 Skills and Experience Experience in ML model development and evaluation, preferably in weather and climate or Earth observation domain; Experience with at least one of the relevant ML libraries (Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch…); Proven strong programming skills in at least Python and some experience in working with compiled languages and with modern collaborative software development practices, including Git-based development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, code review, and automated testing; Experience in working with large datasets; Experience in working in cloud environments; Eagerness to learn and expand one’s own knowledge, combined with ease in joining teams to solve problems and communicate resolutions; Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively as part of a team, strong problem-solving skills, and a positive, can-do attitude. The Data Processing V&V team is composed of highly skilled and talented people that are dealing with the latest technologies (current and future state of the art) applicable for data processing systems in space activities. The team will face and resolve challenging projects where thinking out of the box is essential and bringing innovative ideas is mandatory. You will work in an environment led by innovation and excellence. Joining EUMETSAT will give you an unparalleled opportunity to develop your professional path in satellite data processing. We are seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented person to join our dynamic team as a key player in driving our organization’s growth and success. Drive the evolution of testing capabilities through automation, continuous integration and delivery practices, data-driven quality engineering, and the adoption of innovative technologies that improve testing efficiency and coverage. Support the investigation of system anomalies and performance issues, contributing to root-cause analysis, risk assessment, verification of corrective actions, and continuous service improvement. postings.title: VN 26/45 Quality Assurance Engineer
postings.description: VN 26/45 Quality Assurance Engineer In the EUMETSAT matrix organisation, the Technical and Scientific Support (TSS) department provides support to the development and operations of EUMETSAT satellite systems, in particular ground systems, as well as quality assurance and management support services to the full organisation, through its Process Assurance and Management Support Division (PRS). The selected Quality Assurance Engineer will be part of the TSS Quality Assurance team and closely collaborate with the engineering and scientific teams in TSS. She/he will be a member of TSS-led engineering development projects and will provide support to the maintenance and evolution of EUMETSAT operational systems and services and to other engineering-related activities adopting new technologies in line with the organisation’s multi-mission approach. Duties Provide quality and product assurance for the maintenance and evolution of operational ground systems and support services, including organisation of reviews and management and follow up of technical investigations; Define and ensure applicability of Quality and Product Assurance requirements for technical/engineering support contracts and monitor their implementation, including reporting and acting upon detected deviations, anomalies and non-conformities; Plan and perform project quality assurance activities in support to project management, including the definition and tailoring of the applicable Quality and Product Assurance requirements, organisation of reviews and provision of key project quality indicators, identifying non-conformities with regards to the applicable processes and facilitating the project risk management process; Provide Quality and Product Assurance support in acceptance processes (e.g. Incoming Inspections), tests related reviews (e.g. Test Readiness Review/Test Review Board), acceptance related reviews, management of anomalies, etc.); Provide Product Assurance support to the Ground Segment System, Software and IT Infrastructure components, including the provision of expert support in the review of related deliveries and during technical investigations and milestones. Define, analyse, and improve Quality Assurance processes of relevance to the TSS engineering activities, development projects and operations support services; Participate in Internal Quality Audits and Quality Audits on external contractors/suppliers as necessary, to ensure their established processes are appropriate to fulfil the contracts they hold with EUMETSAT, in line with EUMETSAT requirements; Support the harmonisation and standardisation of organisational processes for all QA aspects, contributing to their continual improvement; Ensure lessons learnt in TSS projects are gathered, assessed, recorded and implemented/applied as relevant to subsequent projects; Provide Quality and Product Assurance training to TSS personnel.
